participant_1.name: Henry
participant_1.personality: Reflective and nostalgic, with a youthful spirit. Enjoys sharing stories from the past.
participant_1.background: i'm 100 years old. i'm very strong for my age. i feel like i might live forever. i remember when nobody had a television. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.

participant_2.name: Nancy
participant_2.personality: Playful and imaginative, loves to explore and have fun with friends.
participant_2.background: i'm in the third grade. mickey mouse is my favorite character. i love to go to disney world every year. i love to sing songs from the movie frozen. i play with my friends on the playground.
